header.name: Stochastic Estimation and control
header.description: This course deals with the estimation of dynamical systems. We will begin with an introduction of probability, random variables, stochastic differential equations, and basics in parameter estimation. These concepts will then be applied to state-space descriptions of linear systems following up to the Kalman filter. Nonlinear estimation methods such as the extended Kalman filter and particle filter will be introduced.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Develop and linearize a measurement model for a dynamical system

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Pick an state estimator based on the system properties (nonlinearities, noise)

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Given a dynamical system with process and measurement noise, design a linear/nonlinear state estimator

lecture_topics: Introduction to probability and random processes: random variables, pdf, total probability theorem, Bayes’ Theorem, stochastic processes, stationarity, ergodicity
Basics of estimation: Parameter estimation, maximum likelihood estimation, least squares estimation, maximum a posteriori estimation, minimum mean square estimation
Estimation of dynamic systems: Specialize to LTI systems, state space form
Nonlinear estimators: Extended Kalman filter, sampling a pdf, particle filter
